welcome.title: Welcome to Cartable
welcome.intro: Cartable mirrors your child's Pronote account into a local SQLite database, so this Mac app can show grades, homework, the weekly schedule, published bulletins, and a Claude-powered chat — all <0>without sending anything off your machine</0>. First, let's connect to Pronote.
welcome.choice_qr_sub: Open Pronote on your phone → Mon compte → Connecter un nouvel appareil. Pick a 4-digit code, then drop the QR screenshot here.
welcome.choice_manual_sub: You'll need the Pronote URL (eleve.html or parent.html) plus the username and password you use on the web.

manual.title: Manual login
manual.stored_locally: Stored locally at <0>~/Documents/Claude/cartable/.env</0>. Never transmitted anywhere except Pronote itself.

qr.title: QR-code login
qr.step_1: On Pronote mobile: <0>Compte → Connecter un nouvel appareil</0>.
qr.step_2: Choose a 4-digit code (you'll enter it here).
qr.step_3: Either take a screenshot of the QR and drop it below, or paste the JSON contained in the QR if you have it.
qr.pin_label: 4-digit PIN you set on the phone
qr.error_no_qr: No QR code found in this image.
qr.error_bad_payload: QR decoded, but it doesn't look like a Pronote login code (missing login/jeton/url).
